title: HTML Error-Fixing Challenge
prompt: Which check is most reliable for finding structural HTML errors beyond a quick visual glance?
objective: Explain and fix one nesting error, one invalid attribute, and one duplicate id.

options: Only change text until it looks right
Run an HTML validator and inspect its diagnostics
Assume the browser repaired every error

expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: nesting, attributes, validation.
acceptance_criteria: Run an HTML validator and inspect its diagnostics
hints: Use the validator output to find the source of invalid structure, then retest the corrected document.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer: Run an HTML validator and inspect its diagnostics
solution.explanation: Reference approach: Use the validator output to find the source of invalid structure, then retest the corrected document. Required structural evidence: <!doctype html>, id=, <main>.

grading_config.correct_answer: Run an HTML validator and inspect its diagnostics

retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
